input.change_text: [VSCode] Fixed `claudeProcessWrapper` setting passing the wrapper path instead of the Claude binary path

output.subject: VS Code claudeProcessWrapper now passes wrapper path, not binary path
output.action_text: Upgrade Claude Code to 2.1.7+ if you set `claudeProcessWrapper` in VS Code. Pre-fix the extension passed the wrapper path where the Claude binary path was expected, so the wrapper never wrapped the right process. No config change needed; behavior matches the setting's documented intent.
